key_requirements: Appoint DPO (thresholds); notify breaches to Commissioner and data subjects; data portability; processor security duties
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Commissioner / Department of Personal Data Protection (JPDP)
penalties_range: Up to RM1,000,000 fine and/or up to 3 years' imprisonment
notes: Amended by PDP (Amendment) Act 2024, phased in during 2025 (DPO, breach notice, RM1M fines)
